title: Paul and Daniel on the Antichrist
source_text: λέγει δὲ οὕτως· „ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοὶ, ὑπὲρ τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ (Χριστοῦ) καὶ ἡμῶν ἐπισυναγωγῆς ἐπ᾿ αὐτὸν, εἰς τὸ μὴ σαλευθῆναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ νοὸς μηδὲ θροεῖσθαι, μήτε διὰ πνεύματος μήτε διὰ λόγου μήτε διὰ ἐπιστολῆς ὡς δι᾿ ἡμῶν, ὡς ὅτι ἐνέστηκεν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ κυρίου. μή τις ὑμᾶς ἐξαπατήσῃ κατὰ μηδένα τρόπον, ὅτι, ἐὰν μὴ ἔλθῃ ἡ ἀποστασία πρῶτον καὶ ἀποκαλυφθῇ ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἁμαρτίας, ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας, ὁ ἀντικείμενος καὶ ὑπεραιρόμενος ἐπὶ πάντα λεγόμενον θεὸν ἢ σέβασμα, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καθίσαι, ἀποδεικνύντα ἑαυτὸν ὅτι ἐστὶ θεός. οὐ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ἔτι ὢν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ταῦτ᾿ ἔλεγον ὑμῖν; καὶ νῦν τὸ κατέχον οἴδατε, εἰς τὸ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ αὐτοῦ καιρῷ· τὸ γὰρ μυστήριον ἤδη ἐνεργεῖται τῆς ἀνομίας, μόνον ὁ κατέχων ἄρτι, ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται· καὶ τότε ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ὁ ἄνομος, ὃν ὁ κύριος Ἰησοῦς ἀναλοῖ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ καταργήσει τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ, οὗ ἐστιν ἡ παρουσία κατ᾿ ἐνέργειαν τοῦ Σατανᾶ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει καὶ σημείοις καὶ τέρασι ψεύδους καὶ ἐν πάσῃ ἀπάτῃ ἀδικίας τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις, ἀνθ᾿ ὧν τὴν ἀγάπην τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἐδέξαντο εἰς τὸ σωθῆναι αὐτούς. καὶ διὰ τοῦτο πέμπει αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ἐνέργειαν πλάνης εἰς τὸ πιστεῦσαι αὐτοὺς τῷ ψεύδει, ἵνα κριθῶσιν ἅπαντες οἱ μὴ πιστεύσαντες τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἀλλ᾿ εὐδοκήσαντες ἐν τῇ ἀδικίᾳ.“ ἕκαστον δὲ τούτων σαφηνίσαι οὐ τῇ παρούσῃ ἁρμόζει πραγματείᾳ. ἡ περὶ αὐτοῦ δὲ προφητεία ἐν τῷ Δανιὴλ λέλεκται, δυναμένη τὸν φρονίμως καὶ εὐγνωμόνως ἀναγινώσκοντα ἐπιστρέψαι ἐπὶ τὸ θαυμάσαι τοὺς λόγους ὡς ἀληθῶς ἐνθέους καὶ προφητικοὺς, ἐν οἷς λέλεκται τὰ περὶ τῶν μελλουσῶν βασιλειῶν, ἀρξάμενα ἀπὸ τῶν χρόνων Δανιὴλ μέχρι τῆς φθορᾶς τοῦ κόσμου. ἐνέσται δὲ τῷ βουλομένῳ ἐντυχεῖν αὐτῇ· πλὴν τὰ περὶ τοῦ ἀντιχρίστου ὅρα εἰ μὴ τοιαῦτά ἐστι· „καὶ ἐπ᾿ ἐσχάτῳ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτῶν. πληρουμένων τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν, ἀναστήσεται βασιλεὺς ἀναιδὴς προσώπῳ καὶ συνιῶν προβλήματα· καὶ κραταιὰ ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ θαυμαστὰ διαφθερεῖ καὶ κατευθυνεῖ καὶ ποιήσει καὶ διαφθερεῖ ἰσχυροὺς καὶ λαὸν ἅγιον. καὶ ὁ ζυγὸς τοῦ κλοιοῦ αὐτοῦ κατευθυνεῖ· δόλος ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ μεγαλυνθήσεται, καὶ δόλῳ διαφθερεῖ πολλοὺς, καὶ ἐπὶ ἀπωλείας πολλῶν στήσεται, καὶ ὡς ὠὰ χειρὶ συντρίψει.“ ὅπερ δὲ παρὰ τῷ Παύλῳ λέλεκται ἐν ᾗ ἐξεθέμην αὐτοῦ λέξει, φασκούσῃ· „ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καθίσαι, ἀποδεικνύντα ἑαυτὸν ὅτι ἐστὶ θεὸς,“ τοῦτο καὶ ἐν τῷ Δανιὴλ τοῦτον εἴρηται τὸν τρόπον· „καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἱερὸν βδέλυγμα τῶν ἐρημώσεων, καὶ ἕως συντελείας καιροῦ συντέλεια δοθήσεται ἐπὶ τὴν ἐρήμωσιν.“ τοσαῦτα δὴ ἀπὸ πλειόνων ἔδοξεν εὔλογον εἶναί μοι παραθέσθαι εἰς τὸ κἂν ἐπ᾿ ὀλίγον συνιέναι τὸν ἀκροατὴν περὶ τοῦ βουλήματος τῶν θείων λόγων, διδασκόντων τὰ περὶ τοῦ διαβόλου καὶ τοῦ ἀντιχρίστου· οἷς εἰς ταῦτα ἀρκεσθέντες ἴδωμεν καὶ ἄλλην τοῦ Κέλσου λέξιν καὶ πρὸς αὐτὴν κατὰ τὸ δυνατὸν ἀγωνισώμεθα.
pass_a_gloss: He says (λέγω) thus: 'We ask (ἐρωτάω) you, brothers, on behalf of / concerning the coming (παρουσία) of our Lord Jesus (Christ, in editor's parentheses) and our gathering-together (ἐπισυναγωγή) to him, that you not be shaken (σαλεύω) from the mind (νοῦς) nor be alarmed (θροέω), neither through spirit (πνεῦμα) nor through word (λόγος) nor through letter (ἐπιστολή) as through us, as that the day of the Lord has set in / is present (ἐνίστημι). Let no one deceive (ἐξαπατάω) you in any manner, because, unless the apostasy (ἀποστασία) come first and the man of sin (ἁμαρτία) be revealed (ἀποκαλύπτω), the son of destruction (ἀπώλεια), the one opposing (ἀντίκειμαι) and exalting himself (ὑπεραίρομαι) over everything called god or object of reverence (σέβασμα), so that he sits (καθίζω) in the temple (ναός) of God, showing forth (ἀποδείκνυμι) himself that he is God [apodosis lacking]. Do you not remember (μνημονεύω) that, being still with you, I was saying these things to you? And now you know the restraining thing (τὸ κατέχον), for him to be revealed in his own season (καιρός); for the mystery (μυστήριον) of lawlessness (ἀνομία) is already working (ἐνεργέω); only the restrainer (ὁ κατέχων) now, until he come out of the midst. And then will be revealed the lawless one (ὁ ἄνομος), whom the Lord Jesus will consume (ἀναλίσκω) by the breath/spirit (πνεῦμα) of his mouth and abolish (καταργέω) by the appearing (ἐπιφάνεια) of his coming; whose coming is according to working (ἐνέργεια) of Satan in all power (δύναμις) and signs (σημεῖον) and wonders (τέρας) of falsehood (ψεῦδος) and in all deceit (ἀπάτη) of unrighteousness (ἀδικία) for those perishing (ἀπόλλυμαι), in return for which they did not receive the love (ἀγάπη) of the truth for them to be saved (σῴζω). And through this God sends them working of error (πλάνη) for them to believe the lie, that all might be judged (κρίνω) who did not believe the truth but were well pleased (εὐδοκέω) in unrighteousness.' To make clear (σαφηνίζω) each of these does not fit (ἁρμόζω) the present treatise (πραγματεία). The prophecy (προφητεία) about him has been spoken in Daniel, able to turn the one reading prudently (φρονίμως) and fair-mindedly (εὐγνωμόνως) to marvel at (θαυμάζω) the words as truly inspired (ἔνθεος) and prophetic, in which are spoken the things about the coming kingdoms (βασιλεία), beginning from the times of Daniel to the destruction (φθορά) of the world (κόσμος). It will be possible for the one wishing to read (ἐντυγχάνω) it; but see whether the things about the Antichrist (ἀντίχριστος) are not such: 'And at the last of their kingdom, their sins being filled up (πληρόω), there will arise a king shameless (ἀναιδής) in face and understanding riddles (πρόβλημα); and mighty his strength (ἰσχύς), and wondrously he will destroy (διαφθείρω) and will make straight/prosper (κατευθύνω) and do, and will destroy strong ones and a holy people (λαὸς ἅγιος). And the yoke (ζυγός) of his collar (κλοιός) will prosper; deceit (δόλος) in his hand, and in his heart he will be magnified (μεγαλύνω), and by deceit will destroy many, and upon destruction of many will stand, and as eggs (ᾠόν) by hand will crush (συντρίβω).' What has been said in Paul in the passage (λέξις) of his that I set out (ἐκτίθημι), saying 'so that he sits in the temple of God, showing himself that he is God', this also in Daniel is said in this manner: 'and upon the temple (ἱερόν) abomination (βδέλυγμα) of desolations (ἐρήμωσις), and until consummation (συντέλεια) of time consummation will be given upon the desolation.' So many out of more it seemed reasonable (εὔλογος) to me to set beside (παρατίθημι), for the hearer (ἀκροατής) to understand even a little about the intent (βούλημα) of the divine words, teaching the things about the devil (διάβολος) and the Antichrist; being content (ἀρκέομαι) with which for these matters, let us see another passage of Celsus and contend (ἀγωνίζομαι) against it as far as possible.
pass_b_english: He speaks as follows: “We ask you, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, not to be shaken from your mind or alarmed, either by a spirit or by a word or by a letter as if from us, as though the day of the Lord were already here. Let no one deceive you in any way; for [that day will not come] unless the falling away comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction, who opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God. Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you? And now you know what restrains him, so that he may be revealed in his own time. For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one who now restrains is still here, until he is out of the way. And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will consume with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearing of his coming. The lawless one’s coming is according to the working of Satan, with all power and signs and lying wonders, and with all the deceit of unrighteousness for those who are perishing, because they did not receive the love of the truth so as to be saved. And for this reason God sends them a power that leads them astray, so that they believe the lie, in order that all may be judged who did not believe the truth but took pleasure in unrighteousness” (2 Thessalonians 2:1–12).

To make each of these points clear does not suit the present treatise. But the prophecy about him is given in Daniel, and it can move one who reads with good sense and fairness to marvel at the words as truly inspired and prophetic. In them are told the things concerning the kingdoms to come, beginning from the times of Daniel and reaching to the destruction of the world. Anyone who wishes may read it; but see whether what concerns the Antichrist is not as follows: “And at the last of their kingdom, when their sins are coming to the full, there shall arise a king shameless of face and understanding riddles. And his strength shall be mighty, and he shall destroy marvellously, and shall prosper and act, and shall destroy the mighty and a holy people. And the yoke of his collar shall prosper; deceit is in his hand, and he shall be magnified in his heart, and by deceit he shall destroy many, and he shall stand up for the destruction of many, and shall crush them like eggs in the hand” (Daniel 8:23–25).

And what is said in Paul, in the passage of his that I set out, which says, “so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God” (2 Thessalonians 2:4), is also said in Daniel in this way: “And upon the temple an abomination of desolations, and until the end of the time an end shall be given upon the desolation” (Daniel 9:27).

It seemed reasonable to me to cite these few passages out of many, so that the hearer may understand, at least a little, the intent of the divine words when they teach about the devil and the Antichrist. Content with these on this subject, let us look at another passage of Celsus and contend against it as best we can.

choices.choice: Origen continues from 6.45 (‘Paul says about this so-called Antichrist...’); ‘He speaks as follows’ resumes that. In 2 Thessalonians 2:1 Koetschau prints (Χριστοῦ) in parentheses; translated ‘Christ’. Origen’s text of 2:2 lacks ‘quickly’ (ταχέως) found in the standard New Testament text, so it is not translated. In 2:3 Paul’s sentence lacks its main clause; ’[that day will not come]’ is bracketed as an editorial supplement, not in the Greek. In 2:7 ‘only the one who now restrains is still here’ supplies the verb Paul leaves out (μόνον ὁ κατέχων ἄρτι). ἀναλοῖ rendered ‘will consume’. Daniel 8:23-25 is quoted in the Theodotion-type Greek (κατευθυνεῖ ‘shall prosper’; ὁ ζυγὸς τοῦ κλοιοῦ αὐτοῦ ‘the yoke of his collar’), which differs from the Hebrew-based English Bibles. Daniel 9:27 is quoted in its Greek form, close to Theodotion (‘upon the temple an abomination of desolations, and until the end of the time an end shall be given upon the desolation’), which differs from the Hebrew-based English Bibles; συντέλεια rendered ‘end’ both times. ‘The kingdoms to come’ alludes to the kingdom visions of Daniel 2 and 7, left uncited because no single verse is quoted. No Psalm numbering involved. In 2:9 the relative οὗ refers to the lawless one, so ‘The lawless one’s coming’ is written out to keep it from being read as the Lord’s coming. ἐνέργειαν πλάνης (2:11) rendered ‘a power that leads them astray’ to avoid the calque ‘a working of error’.
'until he is taken out of the way' -> 'until he is out of the way' (ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται is middle, no agent; 'taken' added one)
'His coming is according to the working of Satan' -> 'The lawless one's coming ...' (οὗ refers to ὁ ἄνομος; 'His' could be read as the Lord's coming just named)
'a working of error' -> 'a power that leads them astray' (ἐνέργεια πλάνης; calque removed)
Closing sentence reordered out of Greek order: 'It seemed reasonable to me to cite these few passages out of many'; dropped the added 'before you'
Translator note corrected: Daniel 9:27 wording matches the Theodotion-type Greek, not specifically the Old Greek
2 Thessalonians 2:1-12, 2:4, Daniel 8:23-25 and 9:27 checked against the Greek quoted; correct; bracketed '[that day will not come]' kept as a marked supplement for Paul's missing main clause

anf_compare.notes: Crombie (ANF 1872) and Chadwick (1953) were not used or consulted; the English is from the Greek.
